Ɛwom sɛ ɛwɔ asɛm a wɔbɔe no mu, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma asɛm no yɛ den; wɔhyɛ no ma edwuma wɔ kasa mu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Wode bɛyɛ dɛn bereku da?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Mennim. Ebia yɛbɛtoa wɔ dɔn a yɛntɔ mmienu no a ɔno a ɔbɛn 9?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ ntɛm ho wɔ me ho, nanso mfrɛ wo ahemma da ma mma wo ahomaso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Nea, nanso mfrɛ me kwan so sɛdeɛ mfa me ho ntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Pɛpɛɛpɛ, mfrɛ wo a ɔno a ɔbɛn 8. Afei yɛbɛyɛ da pa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Pa ara. Mipɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ da pa.

scenario: Complaining politely about a problem

Yɛnka no ma sɛnea wɔde tɔ so adwuma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Faako, me nnya me baabi ho. Me TV no ntumi fa so.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ wo ho sɛ wuhwɛ no. Ɛtɔ so pɛ?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, mihui, nanso ɛnyɛ adwuma. Pɛpɛɛpɛ, menntu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Ebia ɛyɛ ɔkwan tɔ. Ma mihwɛ. Mɛyɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ adwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Medaase. Mennim anyɛ, entɛ, mihyɛ sɛ wubetumi ayɛ no nkwa akyi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Yiw. Mepɛ wo ho sɛ wuhwɛ no. Mɛhwɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.

key_phrases.translation: Mepɛ wo ho sɛ wuhwɛ no.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hɛn a kyerɛw wo kwan ma nsem ma nsem a ɛwɔ film ne TV program.
'good' asɛm a ɛso.

vocabulary.translation: sɛɛ bere a, sɛɛ bere biara

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Mɛhwɛ film foforo anɔpa. Ɛyɛ pɛ paa!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Ɛyɛ nokware? Nsem no kyerɛkyerɛɛ sɛn?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Ɛkasa obi a ɔto so ntɛm. Nanso ntɛm no yɛ sɛn bere bi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Ɛte sɛn. Mɛkenkan pɛpa no sɛɛ bere a, mɛnhwɛ film no.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ sɛ film no paa akyerɛ pɛpa no. Nanso afei mɛnkenkan no.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: A na mɛtɔ me nwoma no, mɛhwɛ no. Meda ase ma wo nhwɛso no!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange
key_phrases.translation: Ntɛm no yɛ sɛn bere bi

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Mema wo akɛse. Mɛbɛka nsɔm pii ka wo. Paa, dɛm na wopɛ dwuma yi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ dwuma a mediw mmarafo pɛpɛɛpɛ, na mɛwɔ nkɔso wɔ akwan a wɔde si awerɛhow gu wɔn a wɔbɔ dwuma no mu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Mensu. Nso, wubehu gu wɔ memeda biara?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, ɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ. Mɛhu gu wɔ Memeda ne Memeneseni.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Pɛ. Bere baabiara na wubehu gu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Mɛhu gu akyiri ka akyi sɛdeɛ mepɔte a ma maa nhwehwɛ mu wɔ dwuma a mɛyɛ no so.

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Abusae: eat / ate / eaten

Kyerɛ sɛ wo pɛ: I like + noun

Kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ firi asɛm biara so
Hyɛ asɛm a ɛfiri asɛm bi so

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Wode pɛ sɛ wodi sika a wɔbɛdi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Mepɛ pasta, nanso mepɛ sɛ mede sika biara a ɛyɛ akɔntɔ a ɛyɛ anɔpa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Yɛwɔ nkuran anantwie ne nkontomire wɔ fridge no mu. Ɛno ara na ɛyɛ pa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Ɛte sɛ ɛyɛ pa. Nanso mepɛ sɛ mede sɛe bi a ɛwɔ nsuo pii mu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Sɛ yɛbɛto sika a yɛbɛka nkuran rice so?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, ɛyɛ adwene pa. Entri yɛbɛdi entwa, na menso mebɛka wo akɔkɔ.

key_phrases.translation: sɛe bi a ɛwɔ nsuo pii mu

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Wɔbisa me kwan? Mɛhwɛ me kompyutaa no, nanso ntɛm no yɛ kɔkɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Yiw. Mɛnhwɛ. Wɔkɔkɔ kɔkɔ no pɛpɛɛpɛ no?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Yiw, mɛyɛɛ. Nanso ɛnyɛ adwuma. Ebia ɛda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Mɔɔyɛ berɛ a. Berɛ nni a ɛyɛ adwuma afeha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Ok, mɛtɛ. Nanso, ɛha ɛyɛ kwan, mɛhwɛ no aha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Mɛnhwɛ. Mɛkɔkɔ kɔkɔ no. Ah, aha! Aha ɛyɛ adwuma!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hwehwe anka  'rent an apartment' (kɔde apaato).
Kan te Twi Amerikani pɛn a, na Twi Briten ne 'flat'.
Hwehwe anka sɛ wɔde ma nnipa anaa wɔde ma nnyɛ.
Afe bɔbɔ a ɛfa so; ɛma yɛnsa kɔde bosom.
Sɛn a ɛto so ne 'cost'.
Hwehwe anka sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde hweɛ no kaa.
Sɛn bi wɔ hɔ a ɛne 'suelo', nanso yɛnka hɔ ne efiesoro.
Kyerɛ sɛ ɛkɛse.
Ma yɛnsa sɛdeɛ ɛso anaa ɛkɛse.
Kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ anaa ɛnyɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Aane, mepɛ sɛ mekɔde apaato. Ɛwɔ hɔ ara?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ɛwɔ hɔ. Kɔde no ne 800 dollar bosom biara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Hweɛ no kɔ so tɛnne ne anoda na adwuma ntɔ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Nnɔɔ, ɛte tɛnne wɔ so. Adwuma ntɔ no yɛ ntɛm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Na ɛwɔ efiesoro bi so? Ɛkɛse suupaa maaket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ɛwɔ efiesoro koro so, na ɛkɛse suupaa maaket mmienu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wubɛba no akɔto.
